title: 全球药企走高端：她偏选相反路线，结果成了胰岛素巨头？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: If you want to serve more patients, then it's about economies of scale, high volume.
segments.zh: 如果想服务更多患者，就要靠规模经济，高产量。

segments.en: And if you want to serve few patients, it's about high value, low volume.
segments.zh: 如果只想服务少数患者，那就靠高价值，低产量。

segments.en: So you decide. I've chosen the former because I want to serve more patients.
segments.zh: 所以你来决定。我选择了前者，因为我想服务更多患者。

segments.en: In the high-stakes world of pharmaceuticals, global giants like Eli Lilly, Sonofi and Navinadask have dominated the spotlight.
segments.zh: 在竞争激烈的制药领域，像礼来、赛诺菲和诺和诺德这样的全球巨头一直备受瞩目。

segments.en: And India has been quietly building a powerhouse in one of medicine's fastest-growing sectors.
segments.zh: 而印度一直在医学增长最快的领域之一悄然打造实力。

segments.en: Bio-similose. Bio-con is at the forefront of therapies designed to closely match complex medicines made
segments.zh: 生物类似药。百康公司处于这类疗法前沿，旨在精确模仿由活细胞制成的复杂药物。

segments.en: from living cells, and it is one of the world's biggest producers of insulin.
segments.zh: 它是全球最大的胰岛素生产商之一。

segments.en: For founder Kiran Mazumbashore, the goal is accessibility.
segments.zh: 对于创始人基兰·马宗达-肖，目标是可及性。

segments.en: At the crossroads with science, money, ethics and human lives collide, she believes, purpose and profit go hand in hand.
segments.zh: 在科学、金钱、伦理和人类生命交汇的十字路口，她相信使命和利润相辅相成。

segments.en: Karamangala, this is where it all began for Kiran Mazumbashore nearly 50 years ago.
segments.zh: 卡纳曼加拉，这就是基兰·马宗达-肖近50年前起步的地方。

segments.en: This neighborhood looks very different today.
segments.zh: 如今，这个街区已今非昔比。

segments.en: Back in 1978, when Kiran started Bio-con in a rented garage somewhere around here, she had little capital and no proven blueprint.
segments.zh: 1978年，基兰在附近租来的车库里创办了Bio-con，当时她资金微薄，也没有现成的模式可循。
